command:
mkdir -p /var/backups/inventory /usr/local/sbin
cat > /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

SRC_HOST=node2
SRC_DIR=/srv/inventory/data
DEST_ROOT=/var/backups/inventory
RETAIN_DAYS=7
LOG=/var/log/inventory-backup.log
DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
DEST="$DEST_ROOT/$DATE"

echo "$(date -Is) starting backup to $DEST" >> "$LOG"

mkdir -p "$DEST"
rsync -a --delete \
  -e "ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o BatchMode=yes" \
  "${SRC_HOST}:${SRC_DIR}/" "$DEST/" >> "$LOG" 2>&1

echo "$(date -Is) backup complete" >> "$LOG"

# retention: remove dated dirs older than RETAIN_DAYS
find "$DEST_ROOT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d -mtime "+$((RETAIN_DAYS - 1))" -print -exec rm -rf {} \; >> "$LOG" 2>&1

echo "$(date -Is) retention applied (keep last ${RETAIN_DAYS} days)" >> "$LOG"
EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh
cat /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh
